displayAddress: Alington House, Alexandra Gate, Hornsey, N8
description:
JOHNS&CO are delighted to present this bright and contemporary two-bedroom apartment situated within the sought-after Alington House development in Wood Green.

Offering approximately 677 sq ft of well-designed living accommodation, the property features a spacious open-plan reception room and kitchen with ample space for dining and entertaining. Large floor-to-ceiling doors open onto a generous private terrace, creating an excellent extension of the living space and providing attractive open outlooks.

The apartment comprises two well-proportioned double bedrooms, including a principal bedroom with fitted wardrobes and en-suite shower room, alongside a modern family bathroom. The sleek contemporary kitchen is finished to a high standard with integrated appliances and ample storage.

Finished in a neutral colour palette throughout, the property benefits from excellent natural light and is ideal for owner-occupiers and investors alike. Conveniently located within easy reach of excellent transport links, cafes, restaurants and local amenities, this apartment offers modern London living in a highly desirable location.
